snippet.title: New York Mysteries: Power of Art Game Trailer
snippet.description:
FIVE-BN STUDIO,  the team that brought you New York Mysteries: Secrets of the Mafia returns with the puzzling sequel, New York Mysteries: Power of Art!

Creators usually create art to benefit the world, but sometimes darkness reveals itself in unexpected ways! Could an unknown evil be responsible for the mysterious disappearance of painted images from their canvases? Police are baffled by this case, so the renowned White Stone Order is called in to investigate. The Order has gained notoriety for its members’ willingness to engage in mystical crimes that few others dare to touch. Journalist Laura boldly takes on such cases as nothing surprises her anymore. However, this incident will lead her to jarring discoveries that would shake even the most experienced detectives. Is there another reality capable of passing its energy to ours? What is the secret conduit between parallel worlds? Find the answers you seek in this mind-melting adventure!

Available for Game Club members on November 2nd, 2023.

https://www.bigfishgames.com
